Content and URL duplicate branches, record-before-enqueue and downloader DNS lookup correct.

HTTP and persistent WebSocket paths, discovery, history/presence and offline push correctly separated.
Policy loading separate from atomic Redis request state, allowed and 429 rejected branches correct.

Adapter: object wrapping/delegation, class inheritance and Enumeration/Iterator unsupported remove semantics preserved.

Factory Method: composition versus overridable factory, pizza lifecycle and regional products, Creator/Product and dependency inversion preserved.
Observer: all subscribe/notify/unsubscribe examples, push/pull and deprecated Observable setChanged/notifyObservers/update(this,null) semantics checked.
SOLID: responsibility separation, abstract dispatch, queue composition, dependency ownership and segregated interfaces checked; cardinalities preserved.
Strategy: duck inheritance problems, behavior families/delegation/setters and three sorting strategies preserved.
CPU: input tables, Gantt boundaries, wait/turnaround values, RR graph, priority groups and MLFQ demotion checked. Corrected document exponential-average formula to match correct figure.

Main memory: base/limit boundaries, relocation arithmetic, page/frame mappings, free list, TLB miss versus fault, page-granular protection, shared libraries, two-level/hash/inverted tables and swap paths checked.

OS introduction: CPU/RAM/bus and interrupts, conceptual storage hierarchy, DMA, SMP/multicore, resident jobs, user/kernel modes, VMs, service categories, syscall parameters and historical APIs checked.

Process: layout growth, six state transitions, PCB/context save/restore, linked queues, scheduling outcomes, PID tree/fork/exec, IPC and socket endpoints preserved. Pipe output routing clarified to open child fd[0].

Storage: HDD geometry, FCFS/SCAN/C-SCAN travel, MBR, RAID redundancy/parity, ports, interrupts/DMA, blocking/asynchronous flows, directory graphs, layering, contiguous/linked/FAT/index allocations and all free-list nodes checked.
Dining philosophers: all five philosophers/chopsticks and adjacent ownership preserved.
Synchronization: lost-update read/modify/write, unprotected illustrative PID race, monitor mutual exclusion/condition queues and possible opposite-lock deadlock preserved.
Threads: shared code/data/files and private registers/stacks, server steps, concurrency/parallelism, data/task parallelism, many-to-one/one-to-one/many-to-many mappings checked.

Virtual memory: resident/nonresident mappings, growth, shared library, fault branches/free frames, COW maps, replacement dirty/valid handling, FIFO/OPT/LRU states and counts, Belady graph, second chance, locality and distinct working sets checked. Fixed valid-address branch in prose and EAT parentheses.
JPA: Owned foreign-key direction separated from Item inheritance, JOINED PK/FK and discriminator, exact example data, MappedSuperclass separate tables/no parent table verified.
Functional interfaces: andThen A→B yields B(A(x)); compose B→A yields A(B(x)); labels and arrows checked.
Stream pipeline: caller loop versus internal traversal, runtime-dependent worker example, filter three squares/map three triangles/count 3 and lazy execution caption checked.
Parallel streams: four illustrative leaf tasks, pairwise combines and final join preserve meaning without fixed core claim.
Stream methods: flatMap two strings→four words and map two items→two names preserve original one-to-many versus one-to-one distinction.
